camera.label: 駅の連絡通路の窓（旧 REF-A）
camera.derivation: old project camera ref-a (src/app/foundation.mjs), solved from File:In_Front_of_Shibuya_Station.jpg (Dick Johnson, 2010, CC BY 2.0) with 7 ground and corner anchors; web [-12.6, 10.2, 68.2] -> plan (x, -z, y); height above the old flat ground. 0.4 m north of the PLATEAU/OSM north wall of the station corridor block way/355250634, i.e. at its window
camera.height_basis: old-project height above its flat ground, which the solve anchored on crossing-level points (about T.P. 15.0); taken as datum metres, +-0.3 m
camera.host_note: camera stands 2.5 m inside the PLATEAU north face of the station corridor block (photo taken through its windows); the host and the overlapping PLATEAU bridge are treated as glazing for this view
